shortDescription: Send operational parameters to WTI OOB and PDU devices

options.name: cpm_filename
options.description: This is the filename of the existing WTI device configuration file.

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Password of the WTI device to get the parameters from.

options.name: cpm_path
options.description: This is the directory path to the existing the WTI device configuration file.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to get the parameters from.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Username of the WTI device to get the parameters from.

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
